definitions.explanation: A building or development that combines multiple functions such as retail, office, residential, and entertainment spaces under one roof.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A mixed-use complex was built in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧や⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This complex has a cinema and a library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A large mixed-use complex combining commercial and residential spaces will be completed next year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{複合|ふくごう}→複合：14114_fukugou⟧ (composite, combined) and ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (facility). Refers to buildings or developments that house multiple types of functions — such as retail, office, residential, cultural, and entertainment spaces — under one roof or in one development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}: large mixed-use complex
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}: commercial complex
- {複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧: construction of a complex
- {複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: development of a complex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}: commercial facility — focused solely on retail and commercial use
- ⟦ショッピングモール→ショッピングモール：27389_shoppingumooru⟧: shopping mall — primarily retail-focused
- {多目的施設|たもくてきしせつ}: multi-purpose facility — a single facility that can be used for different purposes, rather than multiple facilities combined
